title: Come on rejoice and let your heart sing
lyrics: Come on rejoice, and let your heart sing;
Come on rejoice, give praise to the King!
Come on rejoice, and let your heart sing,
Come on rejoice, give praise to the King!
Sing hallelujah, He is the Lord of Lords,
Sing hallelujah, He is the Son of God,
Sing hallelujah, for us He shed His blood.
Sing hallelujah, He is the Prince of Peace,
Sing hallelujah, our joy will never cease,
